title: Outfit switch: Kitenge summer dress
prompt:
A vertical 9:16 before-and-after ad (the result first) for a fashion boutique in Rwanda. Setting: a bright bedroom with a tall mirror. Light: soft window light. Music: beat drop on the switch.
The Kitenge summer dress must look exactly as in Image 1: same shape, colours, logo and label.
0-3s: Medium shot, waist up, locked-off static camera: a fictional young woman in her twenties in plain everyday clothes faces the mirror and shrugs.
3-4s: Medium shot, waist up, fast whip pan: the presenter spins. Sound: a whoosh and a beat drop.
4-7s: Medium shot, waist up, locked-off static camera: the presenter now wears the Kitenge summer dress from Image 1, a confident pose.
7-10s: Clean hero shot, subject centred, slow push-in: on the Kitenge summer dress, its colours and pattern exactly as in the photo.
Clean frames with no on-screen text, captions or added logos.
notes: The presenter is a fictional person described in words, so the face changes between clips. Pick a digital character from the library for the same face every time.
No spoken line: Seedance does not speak Kinyarwanda reliably. Music and sound only; add the Kinyarwanda voice-over afterwards with ElevenLabs.

storyboard.notice: Preview: Seedance arrives with the BytePlus key. This is the shot plan Seedance will film; no credits were taken.
